Feng Yao first served as a cavalry commandant of the Western Qiang, but his repeated military achievements and unmatched valor - a force no army of ten thousand could withstand - led the eighth-generation lord to hail him as 'the foremost man beyond the pass in this age.' He was promoted to Household Cavalry Commander and enfeoffed as Marquis of Tai Zi, known to all as the Tiger that Shakes the Desert.
Tiger that Shakes the Desert

'With the Southern Range at peace, Li Dao held a grand feast for the Three Armies, rewarding the meritorious ministers and establishing the Twenty-Eight Generals' Stars, saying: "The hearts of you all rise like mountains; with the stars following one another, what could stand against us even amid a million troops!" All the generals achieved deeds unmatched in an age, and Zhu Long relied upon them as his right hand - sharing his carriage when going forth, sharing his seat when returning.'
The Twenty-Eight Generals' Stars

The generals of the God-Strategy Bureau responded at once, dispatching troops to suppress the rebel legions. Three armies advanced deep into enemy territory, only to be crushed one by one by the Prince of Nan Yang: General Tian Xian was surrounded at the burial plains by the [Duke of Xuan Huan], pierced through the heart by ten thousand arrows; General Ming Jing was lured to a mansion by the [Marquis of Jing Ji] and had his five tendons severed at the banquet table; General Hu Bu, unstoppable amid the ranks, had his eye pierced by a single spear thrust from the [Marquis of Wu Qu]. The strategists of the God-Strategy Bureau were left helpless, as the Prince of Nan Yang seemed to see through all their plans - the very meritorious officer who once swept the northern frontier clean now sought to sweep away the Dragon Emperor's generals one by one.

[Right Worthy Prince] Wu Daruoti brought harmony to the tribes of the southern desert, uniting the hundred peoples as easily as moving his own limbs. He exchanged Zhen Dan's fine silks for the customs of the steppe and spread the Celestial Court's teachings to reform old ways. He further forged an unbreakable pact with the garrison troops of the frontier passes, joining forces on several northern campaigns against the Chaos tribes, razing their strongholds and clearing the northern desert.
